Entries.Original: Well, time to head out!
I hope we can get there before night falls, though.
Aoi, did you notice any issues on the way here?
None, aside from the time delay. The number of enemies in the area have been decreasing.
That so? Cool, I think that's a good sign...
I don't see what the concern is.
Wait, Ruka. The three rear convoys are stuck.
Stuck, how?
They can't seem to move forward on the path.
Aww, again?
Everyone halt, and stay alert of the surroundings.\nMegumin, can you pull the convoys forward?
What a pain.
Come on, let's just get it done!
The convoys haven't been able to speed up at all. There shouldn't be many obstacles in the way since 30-G is paving the way ahead of us...
Do we know the exact reason why?
Apparently it's related to the size of the vehicles. Yukkie, can you give an in-depth explanation?
Why can't you do it yourself?
Whatever... The materials for the bridgehead were partially prefabricated at the base before they were brought here.
HQ is aiming to retake the area, so the planned bridgehead is pretty large in scale.
For that reason, the materials being transported right now are kind of big and unwieldy. Add that to the fact that the roads are narrow, and it's no wonder the convoys can't pick up the pace.
The convoy vehicles themselves are valuable assets too, so we can't afford losing them either.
Thank you for the explanation. I suppose in this situation, the possibility of getting caught in an enemy attack is high.
Yeah. There've been a few ambushes already.
Even though the Cancer presence has been thinned out quite a bit, that doesn't mean there aren't more hiding about.
In other words, we just need to keep beating up any Cancers in our way and push forward!
You make it sound easy, but we still need to be careful moving forward.
Oof, I'm getting pretty tired now...
Indeed...
I'm right there with you.
Things are gonna get worse once the sun goes down and we can't as well.
We haven't had much night combat trainin', but do ya reckon it's possible for the Cancers to get even stronger at night?
No clue. I've never heard anything of the sort...
They shouldn't get stronger just because the sun's down.
Yeah, that'd be cheating if they did!
Still, keep in mind that combat will naturally feel more difficult if we aren't able to see the enemies as well.
Yeah! Getting ambushed from the darkness is basically a game over!
Guess we'd better watch out, then...
